newsitem.title: USA: Delphi to buy majority stake in Polish firm.
newsitem.headline: Delphi to buy majority stake in Polish firm.

text.p: Delphi Automotive Systems, a unit of General Motors Corp, said Thursday it has signed an agreement to purchase Fabryka Amortyzatorow S.A., an automotive components manufacturing company located in Krosno, Poland.
Delphi will spend more than $30 million for the company, a Delphi spokesman said.
Fabryka Amortyzatorow is currently participating in Poland's Mass Privatization Program administered by 15 national investment funds, Delphi said in a statement released in Krosno.
Fabryka Amortyzatorow is the dominant supplier for shock absorbers in Central and Eastern Europe, Delphi said.
